subject: Targeted control samples request and bridge coverage plan
messages:
From: Megan Lee <security@firmhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FirmHealth Compliance <compliance@firmhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II and targeted control samples — audit period Sep 2025 through Aug 2026

Hi Laura,

We are kicking off our security review for FirmHealth’s integration with Redwood. To complete our assessment we need the following: 

- SOC 2 Type II report covering Sep 2025 — Aug 2026 (PDF)
- If the report period does not align with our review window, a signed bridge letter that attests to control continuity (timebound)
- Targeted control artifacts beyond the report:
  - MFA rotation/verification evidence for admin and service accounts (sample slices)
  - Authentication/event log slices for two date windows (see below) with timezone noted (UTC preferred)
  - Access review attestation for privileged roles during the audit period
  - Any documented exceptions/remediation tickets related to access controls

Could you confirm whether you can provide the report + the above artifacts and an estimated delivery timeline (we're hoping for artifacts within 10 business days)? For the log slices we anticipate small redacted extracts are fine — we do not need full raw telemetry.

Date windows we would like sampled (please confirm if different):
- 2026-01-01 through 2026-03-31
- 2026-06-15 through 2026-06-30

Thanks,
Megan
Megan Lee
Security Reviewer, FirmHealth
security@firmhealth.com
--
Attachment: request-checklist.xlsx (stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Megan Lee <security@firmhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II and targeted control samples — audit period Sep 2025 through Aug 2026

Hi Megan,

Thanks for the clear list — we can support this. A few clarifying questions before we assemble artifacts: 

1) For the MFA rotation evidence, do you need MFA configuration screenshots (idp console) in addition to rotation/change logs, or are logs + attestations sufficient?
2) For access review attestations: do you want a CSV roster of privileged accounts + attestation statements, or signed PDFs from executives?
3) Delivery preference: secure Drive link with limited access + audit log, or SFTP/secure upload? We can do Drive with one-time access if that works.

Prelim timeline: we will prepare the SOC 2 Type II PDF and initial slices in ~5 business days; privileged-account attestation package may take up to 10 business days depending on signer availability. If the SOC 2 period leaves a gap for your review window we will include a signed bridge letter.

I’m looping in Karthik to confirm extraction approach and redaction rules.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
--
(Please treat attachments as sensitive)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II and targeted control samples — extraction plan

Laura,

Plan for artifacts:
- SOC2 PDF: generate official report export (will redact customer-identifying data per policy). Filename: SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_Inference_2026.pdf
- MFA evidence: produce rotation/change logs from IdP (Okta) for admin and service accounts. We will include: event timestamp (UTC), username (redacted to hash), event type, and rotation ticket id. Filename: privileged-access-recert-attestations-2026.zip (metadata + short CSV).
- Auth log slices: we will export pre-filtered authentication events for the two windows you requested. We'll remove IP addresses and any PHI, and supply a header readme describing fields. Filenames: authn-log-slice-2026-01-01_to_2026-03-31.csv and authn-log-slice-2026-06-15_to_2026-06-30.csv
- Access reviews: signed attestation (PDF) from the owning manager for each privileged role; if signed PDFs are delayed, we will provide the CSV roster with manager email + preliminary attest note.

Redaction rules: no IP addresses, no raw session cookies, usernames pseudonymized to HMAC-256 prefixes (we can provide mapping under NDA if needed).

Delivery: we will stage artifacts to a secure Drive folder (one-time access link) and also provide SHA256 checksums for each file.

I estimate the first bundle (SOC2 PDF + authn slices + readme) by Tue, 2026-09-29 EOD PT; full attestation bundle by Fri, 2026-10-06 if signers need time.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
--
Attachments referenced: extraction-runbook.md (stub)

From: Megan Lee <security@firmhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: FirmHealth Compliance <compliance@firmhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 14:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II and targeted control samples — audit windows confirmed

Laura / Karthik,

Thanks — that plan works. A few notes: 
- Windows confirmed: 2026-01-01 — 2026-03-31 and 2026-06-15 — 2026-06-30 (UTC).
- Redaction: HMAC'd usernames are fine; please include a field that indicates role (admin, engineer, svc-account) so our reviewer can map events to control owners.
- Bridge letter: yes, please include a signed bridge letter if the SOC 2 Type II report's coverage ends before our review completion. Our reviewers will want the bridge to explicitly state no material control changes in the interim and indicate the author and date.
- Delivery: Drive link is acceptable; please enable view-only with download and set a 7-day expiration.

We appreciate the turnaround. If you can provide the SOC2 PDF + authn slices by 2026-09-29 that would be great; attestation PDFs can follow.

Regards,
Megan
--
FirmHealth internal ref: FH-SEC-2026-0915

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Megan Lee <security@firmhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2026 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II and targeted control samples — delivery

Megan,

Per our plan, we have assembled the initial bundle and staged it to a secure folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-secure-share (one-time view + download; expires in 7 days). Attached in the folder (and referenced below) are: 

- SOC2_TypeII_Redwood_Inference_2026.pdf (official report export)
- authn-log-slice-2026-01-01_to_2026-03-31.csv
- authn-log-slice-2026-06-15_to_2026-06-30.csv
- privileged-access-recert-attestations-2026.zip (contains CSV roster + any signed PDFs received)
- bridge-letter-redwood-2026-09-29.pdf (signed; included because the SOC2 report period ends 2026-08-31 — this bridge confirms continuity through 2026-09-29)

Notes:
- All timestamps are UTC; usernames are HMAC-256 pseudonyms. A readme in each CSV describes fields and redaction.
- We removed IP addresses and any PII/PHI from the exports.
- SHA256 checksums are available in the folder for integrity verification.

If you need raw audit ids or the mapping table for usernames, please confirm NDA/access request and we can provide under a separate secure transfer.

Next steps from our side: Karthik will follow up to confirm the privileged attestation signatures and finalize the attestation bundle by 2026-10-06. Please let us know if the bridge text requires edits; otherwise we will keep the signed copy as provided.

Thanks,
Laura
